status: Candidate Tier 1 source transcription; not used in numerical fitting

study.title: Furosemide Ototoxicity Is Enhanced in Analbuminemic Rats

protocol.animals: Young adult Sprague-Dawley and Nagase analbuminemic rats aged 50 to 80 days.
protocol.anesthesia: Ketamine and xylazine cocktail 1.0 mL/kg intramuscularly; constituent concentrations are not stated in the paper.
protocol.albumin_intervention: Bovine fraction V albumin infused at a stated ratio of one-half mole per mole of furosemide before the furosemide bolus.
protocol.albumin_timing_caveat: The interval between albumin infusion and furosemide bolus and the infusion duration are not quantified in the described EP protocol.
protocol.measurement: Basal-turn scala media EP relative to a chlorided silver wire in neck muscle; continuous strip-chart recording.

uncertainty_notes: The table does not label the plus-minus quantities as SD or SEM.
Page 3 explicitly labels the preinjection EP values mean plus or minus SEM, but does not separately label the maximum-drop plus-minus values.
Do not use the maximum-drop plus-minus values as SEM or SD in a weighted objective without additional evidence.
ep_table.significance_note: The table marks the two analbuminemic maximum drops with a dagger and P < 0.001; its footnote does not specify the comparator.

figures_and_other_measurements.figure_3: Representative percent-of-control EP curves; not group-average trajectories. The graph does not establish exact individual or group nadir times.
figures_and_other_measurements.serum_albumin: Page 3 gives normal rats 2.2 +/- 0.42 g/dL (mean +/- SD); analbuminemic values were below the assay detection limit of 0.8 g/dL. Figure 2 bars are labeled SD.
figures_and_other_measurements.diuresis: Page 3 describes 3.5 +/- 0.6 and 6.25 +/- 0.7 mL/h without and with albumin as mean +/- SEM, respectively; Figure 4 caption labels its vertical bars SD. The discrepancy is unresolved.
figures_and_other_measurements.diuresis_caveat: The relation between animals used for EP and diuresis is not established by the reported methods.

interpretation_limits: Genotype and albumin infusion are not a randomized manipulation of a single cochlear exposure parameter.
Blood albumin is not a measurement of free furosemide concentration at cochlear transporters.
Preinjection and maximum-drop group summaries are not individual paired observations; their covariance is not reported.
The maximum drop from a representative model trajectory is not generally the mean of individual maximum drops.
The rat study is not directly interchangeable with chinchilla or guinea-pig studies.
